state.question: How many days of paid parental leave do employees get?
state.passage: Employees who have completed six months of service are entitled to 20 weeks of paid parental leave, which can be taken in up to two blocks within the first year after the birth or adoption.

state.question: Can I bring my dog to the office?
state.passage: The office is open from 7:00 to 20:00 on weekdays. Visitors must sign in at reception and wear a badge at all times.

state.question: Does the Pro plan include single sign-on?
state.passage: Single sign-on (SAML and OIDC) is available on the Enterprise plan. Pro and Team plans support sign-in with an email and password or a Google account.

state.question: What is the maximum file size for uploads?
state.passage: Uploads are processed in the background, and large files may take several minutes to appear in your library. You will receive an email when processing finishes.

state.question: When was the refund policy last changed?
state.passage: Refund policy (updated March 2024): customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. A newer version of this policy may be available in the help centre.

state.question: Is the bridge on Route 9 open to trucks?
state.passage: The Route 9 bridge reopened on 12 August after repairs. Vehicles over 7.5 tonnes remain prohibited until the load test is complete.
